title: OpenPLC CANopen configuration, schema_version 2 (several networks)
description: The CANopen plugin's JSON config with a list of networks, one CANopen master per CAN interface (docs/config.md#several-networks). Each network's adapter, master and nodes are the version 1 definitions, referenced from canopen.v1.schema.json. Unknown fields are allowed: the plugin and the deploy tool ignore them with a warning. Checks this schema cannot express (unique names, interfaces and serial devices, IEC locations across networks) are listed in docs/config.md.

schema_version.description: Config format version: 2 for a file with a networks list.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics channel for all networks: one port, one token. In version 1 this is master.diagnostics.

networks.description: The CANopen networks, one master per CAN interface.

not.description: Version 1 keys belong inside a network in version 2.

then.description: A network may list no nodes (scan only) only when the diagnostics channel is configured.

name.description: The network's name in logs, diagnostics, exports and variable names. Default: the adapter's interface name.
